title: ProductAttributes
description: Reference enrichment schema for the Catalog Enrichment Blueprint. 21 attributes, sized per PRD v1.1 §7 'measurement realism rule': guided-decoding cost scales with grammar complexity, so benchmarks must use a realistic schema, never a toy one.
$comment: GRAMMAR CONSTRAINTS (PRD R3, xgrammar 0.1.32 as pinned by TRT-LLM 1.3). Deliberately restricted to keywords with well-established xgrammar support: type, enum, const, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, maxItems, minItems. NOT used: minLength/maxLength/pattern on strings (support varies by xgrammar version and a compile failure here would block H1), oneOf/anyOf/allOf, $ref, format. Optionality is expressed as a ["type","null"] union with the field still in `required`, so the grammar has a fixed key order and the decoder never has to choose whether to emit a key -- that determinism is what keeps OSL, and therefore products/sec, predictable. Every array is bounded with maxItems for the same reason: an unbounded array is an unbounded token budget.

normalized_title.description: Clean, title-cased product name. No vendor SKUs, no marketing shouting, no bracketed vendor codes.

brand.description: Manufacturer or brand name. null if not stated or inferable.

subcategory.description: Free-text second-level category, e.g. 'running shoes', 'cast iron cookware'.

primary_color.description: Dominant color as a single normalized word. null if not stated.

secondary_colors.description: Additional colors, most prominent first. Empty array if none.

material.description: Primary material, e.g. 'cotton', 'stainless steel'. null if not stated.

sizes.description: Available sizes as written, e.g. ['S','M','L'] or ['12 oz']. Empty array if not applicable.

key_features.description: Short factual feature phrases drawn from the source text. Not marketing copy.

care_instructions.description: Care or handling guidance if stated, e.g. 'machine wash cold'. null otherwise.

country_of_origin.description: Country name if stated. null otherwise. Never guessed from brand.

is_bundle.description: True if the listing is a multi-item set, pack, or bundle.

unit_count.description: Number of units in the listing. 1 for a single item.

search_keywords.description: Lowercase search terms a shopper would plausibly type. No duplicates of the title.

short_description.description: One or two plain sentences describing the product. Roughly 25 words; the token budget is enforced by max_tokens, not by the grammar.

extraction_confidence.description: Model's confidence that the source text supported these attributes. 'low' signals a thin or garbled input row.
